payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each boulder, start at index 0, scan right until finding a[i] < a[i+1], increment a[i]. If the end is reached (i == n-1), return -1. Returns the stop position +1.
payload.rationale: The algorithm greedily places each boulder at the first possible increase, scanning linearly. This is a simple greedy scan, closest to two-pointer approach, though no explicit second pointer; other greedy subtypes (exchange argument, sorting, priority queue) are not applicable.
